text:
elaine: Short thread: we need a compact rule for what adapters may attach when crossing Hosted -> Dedicated/Private. Primary goals: prevent PII leaks and keep enough context for ops.
troy: Current mess: a freeform header `x-rw-cx` with all sorts of junk. We should stop that.
nidhi: Suggestion: normalize to typed headers: `x-rw-trace`, `x-rw-route`, `x-rw-tenant` (encoded), `x-rw-meta[k]=v`. Default policy: only trace+route forwarded.
sam: For tenant encoding we support 3 modes: `salted-hash`, `kms-sealed`, `clear`. Default: `salted-hash`. Clear only with explicit admin grant and MFA.
elaine: Important detail: salted-hash must use per-deployment salt (stored in control plane) and standard algo (sha256 hex). Rotate salt on schedule.
troy: KMS-sealed is allowed for Dedicated where ms-level latency is acceptable. Need perf bench numbers before recommending as default.
nidhi: Manifest change proposal:
`telemetry: { profile: minimal|ops|debug, tenant_encoding: salted-hash|kms-seal|clear, debug_window_mins: 30 }`
sam: Adapters should consult a tiny Decision service (control-plane lib) that returns allowed meta keys and tenant_encoding. Cache decision for N seconds and fall back to `minimal` if unreachable.
elaine: Auditing: any switch to `tenant_encoding: clear` or `profile: debug` must emit immutable audit event with admin id, timestamp, and justification and require MFA. Also auto-revoke debug after `debug_window_mins`.
troy: Sampling: respect `x-rw-sample` and cap at `sample_rate_cap` in manifest. Private customers can set a lower cap.
nidhi: Backcompat: adapters that ignore the new block behave as `minimal`. Rollout plan: migrate existing apps to `ops` with salted-hash for 2 weeks, then enable canary for kms-seal on Dedicated.
ci-bot: Created issue ARCH-adapter-telemetry-encoding and attached to milestone `next-rc`.
elaine: Action items: Troy -> perf numbers for kms-seal path; Nidhi -> manifest PR + migration plan; Sam -> Decision lib spec + cache TTL; Ill update runtime docs. If no objections Ill lock this for next release. :thumbsup:
troy: +1
nidhi: +1
sam: +1
